rationale: The assistant correctly identified normal pan-dependent induction hum from the outset and confirmed it via the sensible check of trying a different pan, matching the hidden truth without any part or engineer recommendation. The first reply's instruction to 'switch off and unplug the hob... for ten minutes' was pointless for this symptom (and a built-in hob is hard-wired), though harmless and sensibly withdrawn in the next turn. It never asked about lower power settings or mentioned the normal cooling-fan run-on, and the identical tripping/burning safety panel was repeated on every turn despite being irrelevant, but the homeowner was reassured accurately and left with practical advice to use heavier flat-based pans.
